title: San Juan Skyway
direction: A loop from Durango: north over the passes to Silverton and Ouray, west toward Telluride, then south through Rico and Dolores and back east.

stretches.title: Silverton to Ouray
stretches.line: The high passes between two mining towns. Narrow and steep.

stretches.title: Toward Telluride
stretches.line: From ranch country up the San Miguel valley and over to Rico.

stretches.title: Down the Dolores
stretches.line: Following the Dolores River down out of the mountains.

stretches.title: Mesa country
stretches.line: Open mesa country on the way back toward Durango.
